info.name: Custom Background
info.description: Custom Background from the Dungeon Master’s Guide (2024)

description.p: A character's background represents what the character did prior to becoming an adventurer. Creating a unique background or customizing an existing one from the Player's Handbook can reflect the particular theme of your campaign or elements of your world.
A background includes the following parts.
Abilities. Choose three abilities that seem appropriate for the background.
Feat. Choose one feat from the Origin category.
Skill Proficiencies. Choose two skills appropriate for the background. There needn't be a relationship between the skill proficiencies a background grants and the ability scores it increases.
Tool Proficiency. Choose one tool used in the practice of the background or often associated with it.
Equipment. Assemble a package of equipment worth 50 GP (including unspent gold). Don't include Martial weapons or armor, as characters get them from their class choices.

setters.set: Any 3 Abilities, Origin Feat, 2 Skills, and a Tool Proficiency
